tasks.short: Purchase farm products for processing or resale

steps.what: Verify farm-product demand, quality specifications and available supplier terms
Select the farm-product purchase and agree commercial conditions with the supplier
Prepare the purchase order using decided product, supplier and delivery terms
Check final purchase order, price, quality conditions and supplier destination
outputs: approved purchase order and supplier destination

steps.what: Send the approved purchase order to the specified farm supplier
inputs: approved purchase order and supplier destination

steps.what: Check supplier confirmation and resolve purchase discrepancies

tasks.design: Configure native order defaults in {PROCUREMENT} for the buyer's selected supplier and farm product. Reuse established identifiers and delivery fields while retaining quality decisions, commercial agreement, final order checks, the separately gated supplier send and confirmation handling.
tasks.previous_blocker: Order preparation repeats known identifiers alongside variable quality and delivery conditions.
tasks.enabler_now: Native defaults can populate verified master fields without deciding what to buy.
tasks.still_hard: Managing seasonal supply, variable farm-product quality and commercial uncertainty.
tasks.human_edge: Choose the purchase and resolve consequential supplier differences.
tasks.altitude: Less order field repetition with unchanged purchasing authority.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: purchasing applications support order defaults from supplier and item records; farm-product quality and commercial decisions still need a buyer.

assumptions: Provisional boundary is a purchase within the buyer's existing delegated authority. Any separate manager approval must be added as other-role work, not silently transferred. OPS_SYSTEM is the stock and demand module.

The buyer verifies product ID, grade, quantity, unit, price basis, delivery window and supplier in s1-s2. Existing supplier/item owners maintain master records; missing entries and fresh conditions remain in s3. No new free structured offer capture is assumed.

Native defaults are tested first. Six of 20 preparation points are repeated IDs and delivery fields; 14 remain for variable conditions, input, corrections and ordinary save. s4 and s6 retain full checks and exceptions.
s4 binds the exact final order and supplier before the actual send. s5 keeps its full small time. Ordinary same-system saves remain ungated and earn no saving.
unknowns: Existing order defaults and actual repeated entry
research_questions: Observe one grain or milk purchase and time repeated fields separately from quality terms.

incremental.description: Maintain order defaults and check changed master fields

approvals.approved_version: s4 exact final order, commercial conditions and supplier destination; edits void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Remove 6 repeated field-entry points less 0.7 upkeep. A new seasonal supplier needs fresh quality and delivery terms, leaving only 1.2 points of reusable item identifiers: 1.2 minus 0.7 = 0.5.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Negotiate farm production and purchase contracts

steps.what: Read proposed farm-production terms and verify volumes, quality and price inputs
Calculate specified volume, price and delivery scenarios for negotiation
Negotiate production or purchase contracts directly with farmers
Write the negotiated contract revision in the existing contract document

loop.purpose: Restate specified negotiated changes without choosing clauses
loop.input: Existing contract and buyer-authored exact agreed changes
loop.check: Buyer checks obligations, omissions, exceptions, price basis and whether wording changes the negotiated meaning
loop.stop: Missing agreement, unsupported clause or two failed revisions returns editing to manual
loop.why_not_simpler: Native contract fields and approved clauses come first; variable negotiated wording needs a bounded draft

steps.what: Review the complete final negotiated revision and exact farmer recipient
Send the approved negotiated revision to the specified farmer

tasks.design: Test native scenario calculations in {PROCUREMENT} and contract fields in {CLM} first. Use a bounded draft only for agreed prose changes, retain bargaining and full contract review, and keep the actual farmer send as a separate gated step.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated scenario arithmetic and contract restatement accompany individual negotiation.
tasks.enabler_now: Fixed calculations and source-bound drafting can assist without bargaining or choosing obligations.
tasks.still_hard: Agreeing workable production commitments under seasonal and price uncertainty.
tasks.human_edge: Understand the farmer's constraints and own the commercial compromise.
tasks.altitude: Less arithmetic and restatement with unchanged negotiating authority.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: purchasing calculations can compare specified contract scenarios and bounded drafting can restate agreed changes; negotiation remains human.

assumptions: Provisional boundary is negotiation through a revision sent to the farmer, not signature or contract execution. Separate legal review or signing must be counted when actually required.

The buyer verifies product, grade, quantity, price formula, unit, dates and delivery conditions in s1 and chooses scenario parameters. Extraction and missing values remain counted, not assumed upstream-ready.

Only 10 repeated manual arithmetic points and 3 of 15 prose-restatement points are removed. s4 retains input, clause choices, corrections and ordinary save; s5 retains complete review. Unsupported formula or draft repairs exceeding retained work lower the estimate.
s5 approves the exact final revision and recipient before its actual send. The send retains its full small time. Ordinary author saves are ungated; the model never negotiates or signs.
unknowns: Required contract review and authority limits
research_questions: Compare one negotiated farm contract with native scenario tables and count drafting repairs.

incremental.description: Maintain scenario formulas and bounded revision checks

approvals.approved_version: s5 exact final negotiated revision and farmer recipient; edits void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Remove 10 arithmetic and 3 restatement points less 1 upkeep. A bespoke futures-linked contract leaves only 2 points of fixed-volume arithmetic and 0.5 routine wording reusable: 2 plus 0.5 minus 1 = 1.5.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Maintain farm-product transaction and inventory records and report data

steps.what: Check farm-product transactions, stock counts and source discrepancies
Maintain the original business transaction and inventory records
Compare matching transaction identifiers and inventory quantities across the existing records
Compile the required company or agency data report from selected records
Resolve exceptions and check the complete final report and reporting destination
Send the approved data report to its specified company or agency destination

tasks.design: Test native reports in {ERP} and stock comparisons against {OPS_SYSTEM} before adding a connector. Retain original record entry and exception resolution, generate the actual required report, then send only its final approved version to its single specified recipient through {EMAIL}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Maintained source records are manually compared and assembled again for a required report.
tasks.enabler_now: Fixed identifiers, report fields and totals support deterministic comparison and reporting.
tasks.still_hard: Resolving stock discrepancies and ensuring reported farm-product quantities mean the right thing.
tasks.human_edge: Verify source transactions and own the complete report.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated comparison and reporting with unchanged record accountability.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: records systems can compare explicit transaction keys and generate fixed data reports from maintained records, with exceptions reviewed by the record owner.

assumptions: Provisional boundary is a reporting cycle with one actual company or agency report. No report is created merely to justify savings. OPS_SYSTEM is the product-stock module. Each additional real submission needs its own counted gated action.

The buyer verifies transaction ID, product/grade, lot, date, quantity, unit, counterparty and stock location in s1 and maintains original records in s2. Source extraction and new capture are fully retained; record owners provide the established systems rather than a new free database.

Native comparisons and report templates come first. Only 15 repeated comparison, 20 table-compilation and 2 actual manual dispatch points are removed. No original same-system save earns credit. s5 retains mapping repair and exception work; delivery-failure handling is included in upkeep. More repair than retained requires a lower estimate.
s5 binds the exact report, reporting period and destination after the final report exists. Edits void approval. The dispatch is an actual external send, not a disguised ordinary save.
unknowns: Actual reporting template and dispatch requirements
research_questions: Rebuild one real required report from current records and count repair, review and dispatch handling.

incremental.description: Maintain mappings and report templates and handle delivery failures

approvals.approved_version: s5 exact final report, period and single company or agency destination; edits void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Remove 15 comparison, 20 compilation and 2 real dispatch points less 2 upkeep. With legacy stock units and an unfamiliar agency template, automate only 3 compatible comparison points, 5 common report fields and 0.5 dispatch points: 8.5 minus 2 = 6.5.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Review orders to determine farm-product requirements

steps.what: Read farm-product orders and verify dates, grades, units and available stock
Group compatible order quantities and calculate product requirements against stock
Determine required product types and quantities after checking demand and supply constraints

tasks.design: Configure native demand grouping and stock netting in {PROCUREMENT} against {OPS_SYSTEM}. Remove repeated quantity arithmetic for compatible products only; the buyer reads orders, resolves uncertain demand and chooses the actual required types and quantities.
tasks.previous_blocker: Order review mixes repeated arithmetic with seasonal purchasing judgement.
tasks.enabler_now: Native grouping can compare explicit product, grade, unit and delivery-window fields.
tasks.still_hard: Handling perishability, substitutions and uncertain seasonal availability.
tasks.human_edge: Choose practical demand coverage rather than blindly accept net quantities.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated order arithmetic with unchanged purchase requirements authority.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: procurement and stock systems can group compatible order lines and net quantities; buyers still decide demand coverage and substitutions.

assumptions: Shares are provisional for manual order aggregation. OPS_SYSTEM is the stock and delivery module. This boundary ends at the buyer's requirement decision, before order issue or supplier communication.

Order owners supply product/grade, quantity, unit, required date and order status; stock owners supply lot and availability. The buyer verifies these in s1, retaining missing-field and unit correction. No new free demand capture is assumed.

Native grouping is assessed first. Only 25 repeated aggregation and arithmetic points are removed, not existing system runtime. s3 retains exceptions, validation and substantive requirements work; incompatible cases remain manual and excess repair lowers benefits.
No extra review log or send is introduced. Any ordinary requirement draft save remains within s3 and fully retained.
research_questions: Compare native netting and manual review for one seasonal order book, including substitutions.

incremental.description: Maintain grade and unit mappings and test changed demand rules

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Remove 25 aggregation points less 1 upkeep. New seasonal grades and mixed units leave only 8 points of ordinary compatible order grouping reusable, retaining all other demand work: 8 minus 1 = 7.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Retain farm-product quality, negotiation and purchasing decisions while reducing verified repeated entry, arithmetic and actual reporting work.
skills_to_grow: Version-specific report and order release checks
role.ambitious_version: No autonomous buying or broader service is inferred from these estimates.

job.title: Buyers and Purchasing Agents, Farm Products
